In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the literature on technology transfer for low carbon energy technologies is still in its early stages.
the literature on NSTT and SSTT is inconclusive and that the literature on SNTT is in its infancy.
the literature on technology transfer and cooperation for the development and deployment of low carbon energy technologies in the Global South is still at an early stage of development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Global North has a long history of technology transfer to developing countries, but this has only been a recent phenomenon for the South.
the Global North should not be the only focus of technology transfer and technology cooperation for low carbon development.
the literature on NSTT has matured, while the literature on SSTT and especially SNTT is in its infancy and requires much more attention from scholars.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a lack of systematic research on SSTT, and even more so on SNTT, and a need for more empirical work on the drivers, inhibitors, outcomes and determinants of these forms of technology transfer and technology cooperation.

the literature on NSTT, and to some extent SSTT and SNS, has matured to a point where we can start identifying key factors that determine the likelihood of technology transfer and successful cooperation.
